mapper.sql: id, gmt_create, gmt_modified, operate_time, end_time, uid, user_name, affect_line, ds_id, ds_desc, session_id, status, log_ip, client_ip, work_seq_number, requester, query_id, behaviors, exec_sql, original_sql, message, data_source_type
mapper.update: UPDATE dm_exec_sql_audit SET status = 'RUNNING', session_id = #{sessionId}, client_ip = #{clientIp}, work_seq_number = #{workSeqNumber}, operate_time = #{operateTime}, affect_line = 0, end_time = NULL, message = NULL, gmt_modified = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE query_id = #{queryId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILURE', 'ERROR')

UPDATE dm_exec_sql_audit SET status = #{status}, session_id = COALESCE(#{sessionId}, session_id), affect_line = #{affectLine}, message = #{message}, end_time = #{time}, gmt_modified = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE query_id = #{queryId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING')
UPDATE dm_exec_sql_audit SET status = 'SUCCESS' WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status = 'WAIT_CONFIRM'
UPDATE dm_exec_sql_audit SET status = 'ROLLBACK' WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status = 'WAIT_CONFIRM'
UPDATE dm_exec_sql_audit SET status = 'ERROR' WHERE work_seq_number = #{wsn} AND status IN ('RUNNING', 'WAIT_CONFIRM')
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM dm_exec_sql_audit WHERE uid IN ( SELECT scoped_user.uid FROM dm_auth_user scoped_user LEFT JOIN dm_auth_user primary_user ON primary_user.id = scoped_user.parent_id WHERE scoped_user.uid = #{puid} OR primary_user.uid = #{puid} ) AND #{date} > end_time LIMIT 500
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM dm_exec_sql_audit WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status = 'WAIT_CONFIRM' ORDER BY id
